coment_psicrometrico: Only points with this value will be shown.
coment_diagrama: Only points with this fluid will be shown.
tooltip_en_diagrama: Show this row in the diagram
tooltip_en_diagrama_todos: Show or hide all of them in the diagram
ejes_max_min: Maximun and Minimun of the axes:
tooltip_reencuadrar: Back to the automatic framing of the diagram
ayuda_zoom: Cmd/Ctrl+wheel: zoom · Cmd/Ctrl+drag: pan · Shift+drag: zoom to area · Double click: reset view
tooltip_nuevo_proceso: New process (connects the two selected states)
proc_ayuda_vacia: A process connects two states and checks whether the pair is consistent with the declared type. Select two states and press +, or create an empty one and pick the states in the dialog.
proc_mezcla_adiabatica: Adiabatic mixing of two air streams
col_w_esp: Specific work (positive: absorbed by the fluid)
col_q_esp: Specific heat (positive: absorbed by the fluid)
col_eta_real: Actual isentropic efficiency of the pair of states
col_q_sensible: Sensible heat (the part that changes temperature)
col_q_latente: Latent heat (the part that condenses or evaporates water)
col_shr: Sensible heat ratio: sensible over total
col_h_agua_real: Enthalpy of the added water, deduced from both states
col_fraccion_mezcla: Fraction of the first stream in the mixture
col_m_agua: Water mass flow rate (positive if added, negative if condensed)
col_m_total: Total dry air mass flow rate
proc_sin_modo_calculado: This type assumes nothing, so it cannot compute the destination state
proc_destino_calculado: Computed by the process: it is overwritten whenever the start state or the parameters change
aviso_vinculo_roto: This state was computed by a process; editing it by hand returns that process to manual mode
error_aridad: This type needs {esperados} start state(s), but has {recibidos}
error_destino_inexistente: The end state no longer exists
error_fluidos_distintos: The states belong to different fluids: {fluidos}
error_estado_no_resoluble: State "{nombre}" is outside the range of the equation of state
error_parametro_requerido: To compute the end state this value is missing: {parametro}
error_parametro_alguno: To compute the end state one of these values is needed: {parametros}
aviso_compresion_sin_aumento_presion: A compression must raise the pressure: {valorOrigen} → {valorDestino} kPa
aviso_expansion_sin_caida_presion: An expansion must lower the pressure: {valorOrigen} → {valorDestino} kPa
aviso_entropia_decrece: Entropy decreases ({valorOrigen} → {valorDestino} kJ/(kg·K)): impossible in an adiabatic process
aviso_rendimiento_no_calculable: The isentropic efficiency of this pair cannot be computed
aviso_cierre_discrepancia: The end state does not close with the computed one: h = {valorCalculado} against {valorActual} kJ/kg
aviso_destino_no_calculable: The end state cannot be computed with these parameters
aviso_presion_sube_sin_trabajo: Without shaft work the pressure should not rise: {valorOrigen} → {valorDestino} {unidad}
error_presiones_distintas: The states are at different total pressures ({valorOrigen} and {valorDestino} kPa): they are not the same system
aviso_enfriamiento_bajo_rocio: Cooled down to {valorDestino} ºC, below the dew point ({valorRocio} ºC): vapour starts to condense and the process is no longer sensible
aviso_humedad_sube_deshumidificando: Dehumidifying means removing water, but the humidity rises: {valorOrigen} → {valorDestino} g/kg
aviso_temperatura_sube_enfriando: The temperature rises in a cooling process: {valorOrigen} → {valorDestino} ºC
aviso_humedad_baja_humectando: Humidifying means adding water, but the humidity drops: {valorOrigen} → {valorDestino} g/kg
aviso_mezcla_no_cuadra: The water balance does not close: w = {valorCalculado} against {valorActual} g/kg
aviso_mezcla_energia_no_cuadra: The energy balance does not close: h = {valorCalculado} against {valorActual} kJ/kg
aviso_mezcla_con_niebla: The mixture is supersaturated (ϕ = {valorDestino} %): there is fog and part of the water condenses
tooltip_compartir: Copy a link holding the whole problem (states, processes and settings)
tooltip_descargar_problema: Download the problem as a JSON file
tooltip_importar_problema: Load a problem from a JSON file
msg_enlace_largo: The link came out very long: if pasting it fails, download the problem as a file instead
error_problema_ilegible: The link or file cannot be read
error_problema_version: This link was generated by another version of the fProperties format
error_coolprop_no_listo: The property library did not finish loading
ciclo_con_avisos: Some process in this cycle is flagged for review
ciclo_indeterminado: Cannot be closed: the cycle contains an undetermined process, and how much of its Δh is heat and how much is work is unknown.
ciclo_convenio: Per unit mass, with the fluid's own sign convention: positive is absorbed, negative is rejected. Click the state sequence to highlight the cycle in the diagram.
